items.title: Lithium constraints on India’s transport electrification: system-level impacts and policy implications for the net-zero transition
items.title_en: Lithium constraints on India’s transport electrification: system-level impacts and policy implications for the net-zero transition
items.title_zh: 锂资源对印度交通电气化的制约：系统层面的影响及对净零转型的政策启示
items.summary_en: Energy transition pathways have largely treated critical minerals as unconstrained for the deployment of low-carbon energy technologies. This paper challenges this assumption for India, the third-largest energy consumer globally and a major importer of battery-grade minerals, by incorporating lithium supply limitations within an integrated energy-system framework and quantifying the consequences on technology choices, electrification, and transition costs. This study assesses the feasibility of decarbonization pathways using the long-term energy-system models from a critical minerals availability constraints perspective. Using the KINESYS-TIMES model, seventeen scenarios combine three lithium-intensity sensitivities (kg of lithium per kWh of installed battery capacity) with four availability cases (30%, 60% and 90% of unconstrained net-zero (NZ) requirements, and unconstrained), two dynamic recycling variants, and three runs under an Accelerated Policies scenario of intermediate ambition. The availability is enforced within the optimization; hence the substitutability comes from cost minimization, not from post hoc accounting, and the marginal value of the constraint becomes apparent. Lithium retained in the operational fleet grows twentyfold between 2030 and 2070 from 36.8 to 728.4 kt yr−1 with post-2040 being the risk period. Under severe constraint, within the fixed lithium-ion technology set modelled, the system reconfigures rather than fails; electrification is throttled back, hydrogen and biofuels expand, and hybrids re-enter endogenously. Recycling contributes little prior to 2045 but increases availability to 452 from 218 kt yr−1 by 2070. The shadow price of the constraint is zero until the cap hits and then increases convexly, in the ratio 1.00:2.79:7.94 in 2070 for the three caps, and chemistry innovation delays the cap hit by fifteen years. Under the intermediate ambition, the binding cap is satisfied by 67.9% fossil fuels versus 10.6% under NZ. These results establish material feasibility as a structurally distinct dimension of India’s NZ pathway requiring explicit integration into energy planning alongside emissions and energy security.

items.title: Observed sub-surface warming in Northern Eurasia (1963–2022)
items.title_en: Observed sub-surface warming in Northern Eurasia (1963–2022)
items.title_zh: 欧亚大陆北部观测到的地表以下变暖现象（1963–2022）
items.summary_en: Long-term soil temperature changes in high-latitude regions have been reported mainly focusing on the near-surface air and sub-surface soil temperature because of limited observational data. This gap still obscures spatiotemporal changes and associated processes of vertical thermal changes at multiple soil layers over such climate-sensitive regions. This study investigates changes of soil temperature across Northern Eurasia utilizing monthly temperature data at seven soil depth layers over 1963–2022. This study examines the past trends in the three coarse soil depth levels (up to one, two, and three meters below the surface) across seasons. Results indicate diversity in vertical thermal changes over Northern Eurasia. Most stations show statistically significant warming at near-surface air temperature on annual average, which are attributable to the substantial warming prevalence in boreal spring (96% of total stations) partially with relatively weak prevalence in boreal winter and autumn (47% and 55%, respectively). Surface warming is intensified in the deep soil layers within continuous-permafrost regions, particularly during boreal summer, showing a spring-to-summer shift in the vertical distribution of warming. The results indicate soil depth-dependent variations of warming trends in Northern Eurasia as a response to climate change. This study highlights the value of long-term multiple soil-depth temperature data as a reference for model evaluation over high latitude regions like Northern Eurasia.
items.summary_zh: 由于观测数据有限，此前关于高纬度地区长期土壤温度变化的研究主要集中于近地表空气和近地表土壤温度。这一空白仍使这些气候敏感地区多层土壤中垂直热变化的时空变化及其相关过程难以厘清。 本研究利用1963–2022年期间七个土壤深度层的月度温度数据，对北欧亚地区的土壤温度变化进行了调查。本研究考察了三个粗分土壤深度层（地表以下1米、2米和3米）在不同季节的过去趋势。 结果表明，北欧亚地区的垂直热变化呈现多样性。 大多数观测站显示，年平均近地表气温出现具有统计学意义的变暖，这主要归因于北半球春季普遍出现的显著变暖（占观测站总数的 96%），而北半球冬季和秋季的变暖现象相对较弱（分别占 47% 和 55%）。 在连续永久冻土区域内，深层土壤的变暖趋势更为显著，特别是在北半球夏季，这表明变暖的垂直分布发生了从春季向夏季的转变。 研究结果表明，作为对气候变化的响应，北欧亚地区的变暖趋势随土壤深度的增加而呈现差异。本研究突显了长期多深度土壤温度数据作为北欧亚等高纬度地区模型评估参考的价值。

items.title: A century of streamwater quality degradation by input from urban water infrastructure as revealed by tree-ring records
items.title_en: A century of streamwater quality degradation by input from urban water infrastructure as revealed by tree-ring records
items.title_zh: 树轮记录揭示：城市供水基础设施排放导致河流水质恶化已持续一个世纪
items.summary_en: The transfer of water from urban water networks to natural streams is a driver of streamwater quality degradation that likely occurs worldwide. We develop a new proxy using tree-ring strontium isotope ratios (87Sr/86Sr) to reconstruct multidecadal histories of municipal-water contributions to natural streams. We apply this approach to three watersheds spanning highly urbanized, rapidly urbanizing, and rural conditions in central Texas, USA. Municipal water has persistently dominated streamflow (>90%) in the urban watershed since at least 1945, only 25 years after the initial expansion of Austin’s municipal water infrastructure network. In the rapidly urbanizing watershed, the modeled municipal-water component of stream baseflow increased from approximately 12% to 33% over only 35 years- a 175% increase that coincided with an 85% increase in population density. In contrast, municipal-water contributions have remained low in the rural watershed since the 1840s. The timing of Sr isotope increases in the urban and rapidly urbanizing watersheds indicates that municipal-water contributions can substantially alter stream chemistry within just two decades of water infrastructure installation. This proxy allows the reconstruction of water-quality degradation over periods of urban growth in the 20th and 21st centuries, including periods that predate the initiation of modern water-quality monitoring. Our approach provides a tool for diagnosing the resilience of water infrastructure under accelerating urban growth and climate stress, informing proactive strategies to protect freshwater resources worldwide.
items.summary_zh: 城市供水网络向天然溪流的输水，是导致溪流水质恶化的驱动因素之一，这种现象很可能在全球范围内普遍存在。我们利用树轮中的锶同位素比值（87Sr/86Sr）开发了一种新的替代指标，以重建市政用水对天然溪流影响的多十年历史。 我们将该方法应用于美国得克萨斯州中部三个分别代表高度城市化、快速城市化和农村环境的流域。自至少1945年以来——即奥斯汀市市政供水基础设施网络首次扩建仅25年后——市政供水在城市流域的径流中一直占据主导地位（>90%）。 在快速城市化流域中，经模型估算的市政用水在溪流基流中的占比，仅在35年内就从约12%上升至33%——增幅达175%，这与人口密度85%的增长相吻合。 相比之下，自1840年代以来，农村流域中市政用水的贡献比例一直较低。城市流域和快速城市化流域中锶同位素浓度上升的时间点表明，市政用水在供水基础设施建成后的短短二十年间，就能显著改变河流的化学成分。 这一替代指标使我们能够重建20世纪和21世纪城市化发展期间的水质恶化过程，包括现代水质监测启动之前的时期。我们的方法为诊断水基础设施在加速城市化和气候压力下的韧性提供了一种工具，有助于制定保护全球淡水资源的主动策略。

items.title: Human mobility-associated ambient PM2.5 differences and inequality in China
items.title_en: Human mobility-associated ambient PM2.5 differences and inequality in China
items.title_zh: 中国与人类流动相关的环境PM2.5差异及不平等现象
items.summary_en: Ambient PM2.5 conditions can differ between origins and destinations during both long-term migration and short-term population mobility, but the magnitude and heterogeneity of these differences remain unclear. Here we quantify migration- and mobility-associated differences in ambient PM2.5 concentrations in China using a nationally representative survey of ∼170 000 internal migrants and daily inter-city mobility flows derived from Baidu location-based services. We further examine socioeconomic associations using linear regression model. Overall, the survey-weighted mean origin–destination (OD) PM2.5 difference was −3.29 μg m−3, and 57.15% of migrants moved to destinations with lower PM2.5 concentrations. Migration-associated PM2.5 differences showed substantial heterogeneity by migration type, distance and household income, with moves to lower-PM2.5 destinations more common among inter-provincial, longer-distance and higher-income migrants. Regression models further showed that moving to economically stronger destinations did not necessarily correspond to more favorable PM2.5 differences. At the daily scale, mobility-associated OD PM2.5 differences shifted markedly during the Spring Festival travel season and followed a regular weekly cycle during non-holiday periods. These findings highlight the importance of considering mobility patterns and their heterogeneity when characterizing population distributions across different ambient pollution environments.
items.summary_zh: 无论是在长期迁移还是短期人口流动过程中，起始地与目的地之间的环境PM2.5状况可能存在差异，但这些差异的程度和异质性尚不明确。 本文利用一项针对约17万名国内移民的全国代表性调查，以及基于百度位置服务数据得出的每日城际流动数据，量化了中国境内与移民及人口流动相关的环境PM2.5浓度差异。我们进一步采用线性回归模型分析了其与社会经济因素的关联。 总体而言，经调查加权后的起始地与目的地（OD）PM2.5 浓度差的平均值为 −3.29 μg m−3，57.15% 的移民迁往了 PM2.5 浓度较低的目的地。 与迁移相关的PM2.5差异在迁移类型、距离和家庭收入方面存在显著异质性，其中跨省迁移、长距离迁移和高收入迁移者更倾向于迁往PM2.5浓度较低的目的地。回归模型进一步表明，迁往经济更发达的目的地并不一定意味着PM2.5差异更有利。 在日尺度上，与人口流动相关的PM2.5源区-目的地差异在春节返乡高峰期间发生显著变化，而在非节假日期间则呈现规律的周周期。这些发现强调，在描述不同环境污染条件下的人口分布特征时，考虑人口流动模式及其异质性至关重要。

items.title: Adapting to the risk of Atlantic circulation change
items.title_en: Adapting to the risk of Atlantic circulation change
items.title_zh: 应对大西洋环流变化带来的风险
items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 27 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01961-1Weakening Atlantic circulation could shift temperatures and rainfall across continents, raise regional sea levels, disrupt food production and marine ecosystems, and erode the ocean carbon sink. items.summary_en: Emergent constraints (ECs) are widely used to reduce uncertainties in climate projections, yet their reliability has rarely been evaluated against observations. We apply an established EC approach based on historical global surface air temperature trends and local residual warming trends to temperature change projections over China during 2006–2025 in the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project phases 5 and 6 (CMIP5/6) ensembles. Constrained projections exhibit smaller biases and reduced inter-model spreads relative to raw projections, with Taylor Scores increasing by 25.6% (8.5%), root-mean-square errors decreasing by 18.2% (18.2%), and inter-model spreads narrowing by 45.2% (52.0%) in CMIP5 (CMIP6). The improvements are more robust when referenced to 1850–1900 than to 1986–2005, associated with stronger emergent relationships and a smaller contribution of internal variability. These findings support the application of ECs to regional temperature projections and highlight the importance of baseline selection in enhancing the credibility of constrained temperature projections.
items.summary_zh: 突现约束（ECs）被广泛用于降低气候预测中的不确定性，但其可靠性鲜少通过观测数据进行评估。 我们采用一种基于历史全球地表气温趋势和局部残余变暖趋势的成熟EC方法，将其应用于耦合模式相互比较计划第5和第6阶段（CMIP5/6）集合中2006–2025年中国气温变化预测。 与原始预测相比，受约束的预测偏倚较小，模型间差异也较小：泰勒得分提高了 25.6%（8.5%），均方根误差降低了 18.2%（18.2%）， 模型间离散度缩小了45.2%（52.0%）（CMIP5/CMIP6）。 与1986–2005年相比，以1850–1900年为基准时，这些改进更为稳健，这与更强的自发关系以及内部变率贡献较小有关。这些发现支持将约束条件（ECs）应用于区域温度预测，并突显了基准选择在提高受约束温度预测可信度方面的的重要性。

items.title: Introducing Berkeley Earth’s Data Pipeline 2.0
items.title_en: Introducing Berkeley Earth’s Data Pipeline 2.0
items.title_zh: 介绍伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）的数据管道 2.0
items.summary_en: A rebuilt, expanded and more resilient foundation for the Berkeley Earth temperature record. For fifteen years stakeholders from across the climate, resilience, and research ecosystems have come to Berkeley Earth for a clear, transparent, and trustworthy read on how our climate is changing. Much of that trust rests on work that has, until very recently, remained relatively invisible: the data pipeline that gathers, merges, and quality-checks millions of observations from more than 50,000 global weather stations every month. Following a number of upstream data disruptions last year, Berkeley Earth made a commitment to invest in building a more resilient and robust data pipeline, one less dependent on any one single upstream source of observations, and one that could maintain crucial data continuity in the case that any single ingest product was disrupted or lost. Today we’re excited to announce the launch of Berkeley Earth’s newly rebuilt pipeline 2.0, not only reinforced but expanded to provide not only the most comprehensive but also the most resilient observational temperature record available. Below is an overview of what we improved, what hasn’t changed, and why this matters for the greater climate and resilience ecosystem. What’s New Nearly 3x more data ingest sources and 15,000 new weather stations. We’ve substantially expanded the number of independent ingest sources feeding our analysis, building in redundancy and resilience into the foundational layer of our pipeline. Observations straight from the national agencies. Rather than waiting for observations to reach us through a single intermediary, we now pull observations directly from the national weather agency itself, including: Météo-France, Germany’s Deutscher Wetterdienst, the UK Met Office, Environment and Climate Change Canada, Australia’s Bureau of Meteorology, the Japan Meteorological Agency, and Brazil’s INMET, with more on the way. Additional international observational collections were added, both current and historic, including: the WMO’s WIS2, Southern Africa’s SASSCAL, the DWD CLIMAT monthly summary, and the HARD historic arctic archive. Pulling directly from these collections significantly expands our coverage across the African continent, adds texture to our historic arctic archive, and adds significant redundancy to our existing data sources, ensuring additional pipeline resilience. Faster, and more resilient. Going straight to the source gets measurements into our hands sooner and builds real redundancy into the system. Our data pipeline is no longer dependent on any one source or intermediary for raw observations, leaving us in a far more resilient and robust position. More depth in high-demand markets. Thousands of new additional stations across grid cells new to our analysis strengthen an already world-leading network in the regions our work is used most, including the UK, France, and Germany. Full expanded station archive available on Synthesis. The full library of Berkeley Earth’s station data archive, including the newly added stations, is currently available via Berkeley Earth’s climate risk platform Synthesis. In the coming weeks and months we’ll be working to build near-real-time updates to the data availability on Synthesis, and we’ll update you once that’s available. What Hasn’t Changed The warming trend remains unchanged – Many of the additional stations new to our analysis sit in regions that were already well monitored, so the fundamental historic trend remains unchanged…which is consistent with our expectations. What these additional stations do is create crucial redundancy in the case that a portion of reporting stations is lost, and ensures we’re able to continue delivering our climate monitoring program to our users and clients – no matter what happens upstream. Our methodology does not change – the upgrades to our data ingest pipeline described above sit upstream to the trusted bias correction and downscaling methodologies that define the Berkeley Earth Surface Temperature and BEST-HR high-resolution data products; our fundamental methodology remains unchanged following these upgrades. What’s Next The rebuilt pipeline is faster by design, which means earlier monthly updates going forward, and we expect to have near-real-time data flowing into Synthesis, our high-resolution climate platform, available within the next few months. NOW AVAILABLE ON SYNTHESIS Our complete station archive Along with this rebuild, Berkeley Earth’s full station archive is now open on Synthesis, made available for researchers, analysts, and anyone who wants to get their hands on the data behind the record. A few key stats about our world-leading station data archive: Around 1.6 billion observations from tens of thousands of stations worldwide — one of the most complete land-station archives anywhere. Records stretching back to the mid-1700s, so you can trace change across centuries, not just decades. Observations from every continent,...

items.title_zh: 2026年9月气温更新
items.summary_en: The following is a summary of global temperature conditions in Berkeley Earth’s analysis of September 2026. September 2026 was nominally the 2nd warmest September on record, with a global average of 1.65 ± 0.11 °C (2.96 ± 0.19 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, behind only September 2023. Land temperatures averaged 2.17 ± 0.16 °C (3.90 ± 0.29 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, the 2nd warmest September for terrestrial regions. Ocean temperatures were 1.368 ± 0.068 °C (2.46 ± 0.12 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, a clear record for September and nominally the warmest month of any kind in the ocean record. El Niño has reached record strength on the conventional Niño 3.4 index, and its peak is still expected later this year. Roughly 11.5% of Earth’s surface experienced its warmest September on record, and 53 countries set national September records. Spain, Portugal, Andorra and Italy set national September records, extending an exceptional late summer in southwestern Europe. 2026 now has roughly a 96% chance of becoming the warmest year on record, up from about 93% a month ago. Global Summary According to Berkeley Earth’s high-resolution temperature dataset, September 2026 was the 2nd warmest September since records began in 1850, with a monthly global average of 1.65 ± 0.11 °C (2.96 ± 0.19 °F) above the 1850–1900 (pre-industrial) average. It sits about 0.06 °C below September 2023. The anomaly in September 2026 is nominally the third largest of any month, behind only September 2023 and August 2026. Global average temperature for the month of September in each year since 1850, relative to the 1850–1900 average. September 2026 sits just below September 2023 at the top of the record. On a month-to-month basis, September was nominally slightly cooler than August 2026 though within the margin or error. It remains sharply warmer than other months in 2026. September 2026 continued the run of months above the 1.5 °C mark that began in July, as the warming influence of El Niño has grown. Monthly global mean temperature since 1980, relative to the 1850–1900 average, with the long-term trend in red. Only one month of 2026 has set a record warm month (August 2026) with most months entering as the 2nd to 5th warmest. Depsite that, we have now pushed close to all-time record high temperature anomalies. Record and near-record warmth is expected to continue through the end of the year due to the short-term influence of a record-breaking El Niño. Global temperature anomaly by calendar month for every year since 1850. Over the most recent 12 months (October 2025 to September 2026), the global average was 1.458 ± 0.074 °C (2.62 ± 0.13 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, making it the 2nd warmest such 12-month period on record. It is behind the period ending in September 2024 and effectively tied with the period ending in September 2025, which it exceeds by only 0.003 °C. Because El Niño’s influence on the global mean lags its peak in the Pacific, this measure is expected to keep rising into 2027. 12-month moving average of global mean temperature with its 95% uncertainty range, plus a 30-year LOWESS smooth (red) indicating the long-term trend. Anomalies are relative to the 1850–1900 average. Spatial Variation In September 2026, warmer-than-average temperatures covered most of the globe. The warmth was most pronounced across the central and eastern equatorial Pacific, where El Niño appears as a broad warm band stretching east to the coast of South America, and across the high Arctic, including the Canadian Arctic Archipelago. Large positive anomalies also covered western and central Europe and the western Mediterranean, the western North Atlantic off North America, Australia, and much of northern and central Asia. Some of the largest anomalies anywhere were over West Antarctica. The most prominent cool anomaly was elsewhere on Antarctica, centered on the Weddell Sea sector and stretching along parts of the East Antarctic coast, with smaller cool areas over the Greenland ice sheet, along the west coast of the United States, and at the southern tip of South America. September 2026 surface temperature anomalies relative to the 1951–1980 average. The warm band across the equatorial Pacific reflects El Niño. Gray areas indicate regions with insufficient data this month. Roughly 11.5% of Earth’s surface experienced its locally warmest September on record (about 9.3% of land and 12.7% of ocean surfaces), and 80.3% of the surface was warmer than average. The largest contiguous region of record warmth occurred in the Eastern tropical Pacific, where a record-breaking El Niño event is underway. Record warmth also covered parts of the tropical and western North Atlantic including the Gulf of Mexico and the Caribbean, Iberia and the western Mediterranean, northwest Africa, the Sahel and the Horn of Africa, the Arabian Peninsula and the Persian Gulf, much of the Indian Ocean, maritime Southeast Asia, and parts of northern Russia and Kazakhstan....
items.summary_zh: 以下是伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）对2026年9月全球气温状况的分析摘要。2026年9月名义上是有记录以来第二暖的9月，全球平均气温比1850–1900年的平均值高出1.65 ± 0.11 °C （2.96 ± 0.19 °F），仅次于2023年9月。 陆地气温平均比1850–1900年的平均值高出2.17 ± 0.16 °C（3.90 ± 0.29 °F），这是陆地区域有记录以来第二暖的9月。 海洋温度较1850–1900年平均值高出1.368 ± 0.068 °C（2.46 ± 0.12 °F），这不仅是9月份的明确纪录，从名义上讲也是海洋观测史上最暖的月份。 根据传统的尼诺3.4指数，厄尔尼诺现象已达到有记录以来的最强强度，预计其峰值仍将在今年晚些时候出现。地球表面约11.5%的区域经历了有记录以来最热的9月，53个国家创下了9月国家高温纪录。 西班牙、葡萄牙、安道尔和意大利均刷新了9月国家纪录，延续了西南欧这一非同寻常的夏末天气。2026年成为有记录以来最暖年份的概率目前约为96%，较一个月前的约93%有所上升。 全球概况 根据伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）的高分辨率气温数据集，2026年9月是自1850年有记录以来第二暖的9月，全球月平均气温比1850–1900年（工业革命前）的平均值高出1.65 ± 0.11 °C （2.96 ± 0.19 °F），较1850–1900年（工业革命前）的平均值高出该数值。这一数值比2023年9月低约0.06 °C。 2026年9月的异常值名义上为历年各月中的第三高，仅次于2023年9月和2026年8月。自1850年以来各年9月的全球平均气温，相对于1850–1900年的平均值。 2026年9月的温度仅略低于2023年9月，并列历史最高纪录。从月与月之间的对比来看，9月的温度名义上略低于2026年8月，但仍在误差范围内。与2026年的其他月份相比，9月的温度仍然明显更高。 2026年9月延续了自7月以来月均气温持续高于1.5 °C的趋势，这是由于厄尔尼诺现象带来的增温效应……
